question: Is the inertial angular-momentum direction L-hat recoverable from the s008 28-feature LC set plus 6 simple PAB geometric features, enough to prune the omega-direction grid?
hypothesis: L-hat (a conserved single 3-vector) falls out of LC features well enough to collapse the omega-direction grid to a small precession disc.
narrative_md: Decisive negative: L-hat direction in J2000 is NOT operationally recoverable from the s008 LC features + 6 PAB geometric features. Best holdout median 74.3 deg vs 89.2 deg random (beats random by only ~15 deg); 0% within 20 deg, 15% within 45 deg -- decision WEAK. The LC feature set extracts omega-MAGNITUDE info (pol_diam, |omega|) but essentially no omega-DIRECTION info, so omega-direction grid pruning by an L-hat cone prior is not unlocked. Supervised regression on truth L-hat labels, so it reads truth as input.
